CN:
5月23日
　　尼尔说这条路他走过七次。
　　一路上他说了三遍，我不信——如果他真的走过七次，为什么连帐篷都不会搭？我蹲在他身后，看他第三次把帐篷布穿反，雪水渗进手套，冷得像在舔我的骨头。
　　万幸，我们在天黑前支起了帐篷。

剩余物资：
面包6份    佩姬为我们准备了18磅分成了8份
肉干和肉肠5份
糖1罐
黄油4块
酒3瓶      酒3瓶 → 2瓶（晚上庆祝消耗1瓶）
水5瓶      暂时充足，路上可以留意水源
EN:
May 23rd
　　Neil said he has walked this path seven times.
　　He said it three times along the way, but I don't believe it—if he really had walked it seven times, why wouldn't he even know how to set up a tent? I crouched behind him, watching him put the tent fabric on backward for the third time. Snow water seeped into my gloves, cold as if it were licking my bones.
　　Fortunately, we set up the tent before dark.

Remaining supplies:
Bread: 6 portions (Peggy prepared 18 lbs for us, divided into 8 portions)
Dried meat and sausages: 5 portions
Sugar: 1 jar
Butter: 4 blocks
Wine: 3 bottles (Wine: 3 bottles → 2 bottles (1 consumed for the evening celebration))
Water: 5 bottles (Temporarily sufficient; can keep an eye out for water sources on the way)

<Assistant_Title2>President: </>The President is the leader of the club, holding the highest authority and capable of representing the club in handling all internal management and diplomatic rights. 
<Assistant_Title2>Vice President: </>The Vice President is an important position that supports the President, holding high-level authority second only to the President. They can act on behalf of the President to exercise certain internal management and diplomatic rights, and are appointed by the President. 
<Assistant_Title2>Director: </>A Director is a management position within the club, possessing a certain degree of management authority. They are appointed by the President, with a maximum of 3. 
<Assistant_Title2>Group Leader: </>A Group Leader is the core management for club activities, responsible for the appointment and dismissal of members within the group, organizing league teams, and other gameplay activities. <Assistant_Title2>Club Star: </>The Club Star is the face of the club, responsible for recruiting and welcoming new members. They are appointed by the President, with a maximum of 2. 
<Assistant_Title2>Full Member: </>Full Members are the backbone of the club and can participate in guild gameplay activities. <Assistant_Red>Some activities only support participation by Full Members</>. 
<Assistant_Title2>Probationary Member: </>Probationary members are the reserve force of the club. They cannot participate in some guild gameplay. They can continue to work hard, stay active, and contact management to join as a member. 
<Assistant_Title2>Position Adjustment: </>Club members can concurrently hold management positions, group positions, and the Club Star position; management positions include President, Vice President, and Director.

<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任一教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择玩法【原著瞬间】，选中点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【原著瞬间】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2.完成交互</>
到达目标地点后，交互点击【触摸】，重温过往的记忆。
<Assistant_Title3>3.获得奖励</>
【触摸】后即可获得奖励，并增加对应地图秩序世界完成度。

<Assistant_Title1>【Moments from the Original Work】</>

<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Enter Gameplay</>

<Assistant_Property2>TRPG Entry:</>Open the menu to enter 【TRPG】, join any organization, select the 【Moments from the Original Work】 gameplay in the 【Order World】, and click 【Go】 to automatically pathfind.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry: Open the map, switch to the 【Exploration】 tab, view the 【Moments from the Original Work】 gameplay icon in 【World Details】, follow the icon's guidance to find the corresponding marker on the map, and click 【Go】 to automatically pathfind.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Complete Interaction</>
After reaching the target location, interact by clicking 【Touch】 to relive past memories.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Obtain Rewards</>
After 【Touching】, you will receive rewards and increase the completion progress of the corresponding Order World map.

EN:
<Assistant_Title1>【Bard】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction:</>When exploring various places, you will occasionally hear whispers with a clear sense of direction echoing in your ears. Follow the sound to gradually approach its source, and you will find the Bard.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide:</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Find the Bard</>
You can go to the Bard in any of the following ways:
<Assistant_Property2>TRPG Entrance:</>Open the menu to enter 【TRPG】, join any sect, select 【Bard】 in the 【Order World】, and click 【Go】 to automatically pathfind.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entrance:</>Open the map, switch to the 【Exploration】 tab, click the Bard icon on the map to track and automatically pathfind.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Listen to the Melody</>
After arriving at the target location, follow the sound waves at your feet to find the source of the sound, talk to the Bard, and choose the corresponding interaction method.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Complete the Challenge</>
Find the melody: Turn on <Assistant_System>spirit vision</>, find the three musical notes scattered nearby, and after collecting them, you can open the reward chest.
Hum the melody or analyze the melody: Complete the throwing check according to the prompts; if the check is successful, you can complete the challenge and receive rewards.

    <Assistant_Property1>置景</>（如有使用）

    <Assistant_Property1>Chief:</>All member characters (action range configurable based on the corresponding player's unlock range), <Assistant_Property1>Camera</>, <Assistant_Property1>Scene</> (configurable range based on Chief's unlock range), <Assistant_Property1>Set Pieces</> (configurable range based on Chief's unlock range), <Assistant_Property1>Wind Direction</>, <Assistant_Property1>Color Grading</>.

    <Assistant_Property1>Set Pieces</> (if used)
